_readme: MYSTERY REWARD — the whole reward system lives here.
Nothing about which rewards exist, what they say, what they are worth or
how often they appear is written anywhere else. tools/build-rewards.js
renders the markup from this file and src/scripts/reward.js picks from it;
neither knows a reward by name. To change the promotion, change this file
and rebuild — no CSS and no JavaScript needs touching.
WEIGHT is relative, not a percentage. A reward with weight 30 appears
three times as often as one with weight 10. The numbers need not total
HONESTY ABOUT WHAT THIS IS. The pick happens in the visitor's browser and
is stored in their browser. Anyone who wants to can read this file, clear
their storage and draw again — so these codes are a marketing device, not
a security control. Whoever honours a code has to check it by hand, the
same way they check any other quote. docs/96 §6 sets out what a backend
would have to add before that stopped being true.
